You are a programming expert.

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From c79484f68b164a4b59c85b7a5008455ddd7af6fb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: YueHaibing <yuehaibing@huawei.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2020 15:13:37 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/mediatek: Fix Kconfig warning

WARNING: unmet direct dependencies detected for MTK_MMSYS
  Depends on [n]: (ARCH_MEDIATEK [=y] || COMPILE_TEST [=n]) && COMMON_CLK_MT8173_MMSYS [=n]
  Selected by [y]:
  - DRM_MEDIATEK [=y] && HAS_IOMEM [=y] && DRM [=y] && (ARCH_MEDIATEK [=y] || ARM && COMPILE_TEST [=n]) && COMMON_CLK [=y] && HAVE_ARM_SMCCC [=y] && OF [=y]

Make DRM_MEDIATEK depend on MTK_MMSYS to fix this.

Fixes: 2c758e301ed9 ("soc / drm: mediatek: Move routing control to mmsys device")
Signed-off-by: YueHaibing <yuehaibing@huawei.com>
Reviewed-by: Enric Balletbo i Serra <enric.balletbo@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Chun-Kuang Hu <chunkuang.hu@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/Kconfig b/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/Kconfig
index c420f5a3d33b..aa74aac3cbcc 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/Kconfig
@@ -6,12 +6,12 @@ config DRM_MEDIATEK
 	depends on COMMON_CLK
 	depends on HAVE_ARM_SMCCC
 	depends on OF
+	depends on MTK_MMSYS
 	select DRM_GEM_CMA_HELPER
 	select DRM_KMS_HELPER
 	select DRM_MIPI_DSI
 	select DRM_PANEL
 	select MEMORY
-	select MTK_MMSYS
 	select MTK_SMI
 	select VIDEOMODE_HELPERS
 	help
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/Kconfig`**
   - The line `select MTK_MMSYS` has been changed to `depends on MTK_MMSYS`. This modification alters the relationship of the `DRM_MEDIATEK` configuration option with `MTK_MMSYS`, making it a dependency rather than a selection.

### Relationships

- The change establishes that `DRM_MEDIATEK` now requires `MTK_MMSYS` to be enabled for it to be configured, addressing the unmet direct dependencies warning. This ensures that the configuration is logically consistent and prevents potential issues during the build process related to the `MTK_MMSYS` component. The previous selection implied that `MTK_MMSYS` would always be included, which was not the case, leading to the warning.

Here is the commit message:
drm/mediatek: Fix Kconfig warning

WARNING: unmet direct dependencies detected for MTK_MMSYS
  Depends on [n]: (ARCH_MEDIATEK [=y] || COMPILE_TEST [=n]) && COMMON_CLK_MT8173_MMSYS [=n]
  Selected by [y]:
  - DRM_MEDIATEK [=y] && HAS_IOMEM [=y] && DRM [=y] && (ARCH_MEDIATEK [=y] || ARM && COMPILE_TEST [=n]) && COMMON_CLK [=y] && HAVE_ARM_SMCCC [=y] && OF [=y]

Make DRM_MEDIATEK depend on MTK_MMSYS to fix this.

Fixes: 2c758e301ed9 ("soc / drm: mediatek: Move routing control to mmsys device")
Signed-off-by: YueHaibing <yuehaibing@huawei.com>
Reviewed-by: Enric Balletbo i Serra <enric.balletbo@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Chun-Kuang Hu <chunkuang.hu@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by an unmet direct dependency for the `MTK_MMSYS` configuration option, which was incorrectly selected by `DRM_MEDIATEK` without ensuring that `MTK_MMSYS` was enabled. This inconsistency could lead to build failures or runtime issues when the `DRM_MEDIATEK` option was used without the necessary `MTK_MMSYS` support.

Here is the patch:
 	depends on HAVE_ARM_SMCCC
 	depends on OF
+	depends on MTK_MMSYS
 	select DRM_GEM_CMA_HELPER
 	select DRM_KMS_HELPER
 	select DRM_PANEL
 	select MEMORY
-	select MTK_MMSYS
 	select MTK_SMI
 	select VIDEOMODE_HELPERS

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```plaintext
- select MTK_MMSYS
```
Reason:
The `select MTK_MMSYS` statement in the `DRM_MEDIATEK` configuration option incorrectly forces the selection of `MTK_MMSYS` without ensuring that it is enabled, leading to unmet dependencies. This inconsistency can cause build failures or runtime issues when `DRM_MEDIATEK` is used without the necessary support for `MTK_MMSYS`.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```plaintext
+ depends on MTK_MMSYS
```
Reason:
By changing `select MTK_MMSYS` to `depends on MTK_MMSYS`, the patch ensures that `DRM_MEDIATEK` will only be enabled if `MTK_MMSYS` is also enabled. This resolves the unmet dependency issue, ensuring that the necessary support is present when `DRM_MEDIATEK` is selected, thus preventing potential build failures or runtime issues.
